summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of its common shares under subscription agreements, declared regular monthly distributions, and disclosed NAV and portfolio metrics. The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine current report of the fund's ordinary capital-raising and distribution activities. No action is required, and there is no deal to watch.
